title: Sample Topic Quiz
description: Practice multiple-choice quiz with instant feedback and explanations.

items.question: What is the primary role of a compiler?

options.text: Executes machine code line by line
Translates high-level source code into machine code
Manages computer hardware and memory directly
Serves as a text editor for programmers

items.explanation: A compiler translates entire high-level source code into target machine code prior to execution.

items.question: Which data structure uses LIFO (Last-In, First-Out)?
items.explanation: A stack operates on the Last-In, First-Out principle, where the most recently pushed item is popped first.

items.question: What is the average time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
items.explanation: Binary search halves the search range with each step, yielding O(log n) time complexity.
